build_gpu_timer: build a GPU timer that measures CUDA execution time of a closure and returns the result and elapsed milliseconds
create_csv_logger: create a CSV logger that writes typed header columns and appends formatted log rows to a CSV file
create_average_meter: create an average meter that tracks current value, sum, count, average, min, and max over repeated updates
get_jepa_rootpath: get the JEPA project root directory path by traversing three parent directories from the logging module
get_git_information: get the current git branch name and commit hash from the JEPA repository root
